name: prose cells measured while hidden are not watched
why: Without the watch a prose cell in a sub-table rendered hidden keeps its height clamp but never gets its toggle: opening the sub-table later does not measure it again (user-profile's Bio, debug/mb-user-atj-final.html).
grep: long Bio left in a hidden sub-table

name: the watch fires but does not set the table up again
why: The observer must re-run initCollapsableColumns() on the table once a watched cell is laid out and cut off; noticing the size alone adds no toggle.

edits.find:
Lib.debug('collapse', '_collapseWatchUnlaid: a prose cell measured while hidden is cut off; setting the table up again.');
                initCollapsableColumns(table);
